== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>4078b5bd718cd32cee4f9efd0328c94c8df22a10</code>.
